no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Repligen Corporation is a bioprocessing tools and consumables company supplying filtration, chromatography, process analytics, and proteins to biopharma manufacturers. Per its FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-26), Repligen does not develop or run clinical trials of therapeutic candidates; legacy drug programs (RG1068 secretin, RG2417, RG2133, RG2077) were terminated/completed and divested years ago. No active P1/P2/P3 assets exist.
